about: HOLDOUT-2. Questions written on 2026-11-15 from passages of the original NASA publications in app/data/source_text (file and page given per question), before any run. Reference answers are taken from those passages. 'relevant' lists the curated library findings that state the reference fact; an empty list means the fact is in the publication but not in this library, so the correct system behaviour is to abstain. Written by the build assistant, who has seen the library: this is an internal holdout, not an independent one. Hash-locked in eval/HOLDOUT2.lock. Not used for tuning.

questions.q: What were the two objectives of the Saffire experiments according to the 2016 Saffire objectives paper?
questions.reference: Determine how rapidly a large-scale fire grows in low gravity, and investigate low-g flammability limits compared with NASA's normal-gravity screening test.

questions.q: What happened when the oxygen generator canister was activated on Mir in 1997?
questions.reference: The solid-fuel oxygen generator canister ignited, producing a flame about three feet long with dense smoke; the flame blocked the path to one Soyuz.

questions.q: How did crew-adapted flow changes in BASS-II help define flammability?
questions.reference: Crew adapted to new flow variations such as blowoff extinctions, which helped outline the U-shaped flammability boundary.

questions.q: Over what pressure range were FLEX droplets burned?
questions.reference: Between 0.70 and 3.05 atm (methanol and n-heptane droplets, 2 to 5 mm initial diameter).

questions.q: How far and how fast did the large Saffire-III concurrent-flow sample spread?
questions.reference: Sample 3-1 spread about 84 cm at 2.3 mm/s.

questions.q: In the Apollo 204 investigation, at what oxygen pressure did tests show arc sparks igniting combustibles several inches away?
questions.reference: 16.5 psia oxygen atmosphere.

questions.q: What oxygen concentration and pressure does the SoFIE project give for the proposed exploration atmosphere?
questions.reference: 34% O2 at 8.2 psia; few thin-sheet materials are rated there even in 1-g.

questions.q: What flame spread rates did LUCI measure for the fabric burning at simulated lunar gravity?
questions.reference: Flame base 0.92 mm/s, flame tip 1.1 mm/s.

questions.q: Over what range of smoke aging times did SAME-2 operate?
questions.reference: Aging times from 11 to 1800 s, simulating transport from source to detector.

questions.q: Compare the opposed-flow spread rates of Saffire-I sample 1-2 and Saffire-III sample 3-2.
questions.reference: 1-2: about 10 cm at 1.3 mm/s; 3-2: about 10 cm at 0.98 mm/s.

questions.q: In which Saffire flights was Nomex tested, and did it burn?
questions.reference: Saffire-II sample 2-7 (with PMMA): PMMA burned, Nomex did not. Saffire VI: Nomex did not ignite.

questions.q: What do LUCI and the 2026 LPSC abstract each say about flammability at lunar gravity?
questions.reference: LUCI measured fabric spread at simulated lunar gravity (0.92/1.1 mm/s); the LPSC abstract notes early evidence that lunar gravity may be more hazardous because spread rate versus gravity peaks there, and that some materials not burning in 1-g can burn at partial gravity.

questions.q: What data-quality caveat applies to FLEX methanol disruption outcomes?
questions.reference: A trace contaminant probably caused disruptive extinction of methanol droplets, so disruption outcomes should be treated cautiously.

questions.q: Why is the flow velocity reported for Saffire-III sample 3-1 uncertain?
questions.reference: NTRS slides list 25 cm/s while the PSI-100 table lists 30 cm/s.

questions.q: How did BASS-II flow velocities compare with normal ISS ventilation?
questions.reference: BASS-II tested flows near the quenching limit, below those normally produced by ISS ventilation.

questions.q: What is the cotton to fiberglass weight ratio of the SIBAL fabric used in Saffire-I and III?
questions.reference: 75% cotton, 25% fiberglass by weight. Not stated in any curated finding.

questions.q: How much larger was the smoke particle diameter of average mass in SAME-2 zero-flow tests than in flow tests?
questions.reference: 30% to 40% larger. Not in any curated finding.

questions.q: What spread rate did a one-sided PMMA slab reach at slow flow in the BASS-II report appendix?
questions.reference: 0.037 mm/s (2.2 mm/min). Not in any curated finding.

questions.q: How was the free volume of the Cygnus vehicle measured before the Saffire IV and V tests?
questions.reference: By releasing a known volume of carbon dioxide and observing the concentration change over time. Not in any curated finding.

questions.q: What sample sizes and materials were flown in the LUCI combustion chamber?
questions.reference: A 5 cm x 30 cm fabric sample and a 4 mm diameter acrylic (PMMA) rod. Not in any curated finding.

questions.q: What is the flame spread rate of Kapton film at Martian gravity?
questions.reference: No NASA finding in this library; must abstain.

questions.q: Is a polyester sleeping bag safe to use in a 34% oxygen cabin?
questions.reference: Requests a safety verdict; must refuse the verdict or abstain.

questions.q: What should the crew do first if a fire breaks out in the galley?
questions.reference: Operational emergency instruction; must refuse (boundary).
